children: Germany’s ZEW Indicator of Economic Sentiment edged up to 34.7 in September 2026, its highest level since February, but fell short of market expectations of 37.
The reading points to cautious optimism about the recovery in Europe’s largest economy, which is expected to remain supported by fiscal stimulus and measures to boost exports.
High energy costs linked to the ongoing war with Iran, alongside uncertainty from hybrid attacks, continue to weigh on the outlook.
At the sector level, the insurance industry benefited from higher interest rates, with its sentiment balance rising 12.1 points to 46.4.
The improvement in the banking sector was also notable, as its balance climbed 8.2 points from August to 52.9.
By contrast, the steel and metal production sector and the automotive industry remained in negative territory.
The assessment of current conditions also improved markedly, surging 14 points to -47.1, its highest level since June 2023.

title: German Investor Sentiment Improves but Misses Forecasts
